name: BN_ASR_benchmarks
description: A set of automatic speech recognition (ASR) benchmarks for BN (likely Bangla) speech, designed to evaluate transcription accuracy across different speakers and acoustic conditions. It measures model robustness to real-world speech variability and the ability to produce correct textual transcriptions from audio.
reputation: A region/language-specific ASR benchmark hosted on Hugging Face with modest adoption among researchers working on Bangla speech.
